name: AnyPS5
description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
one_liner: A tool that converts PS5 game software so it can run directly on a Windows or Linux PC, without needing a separate emulator program.
buyer: Honestly, mostly hobbyist PS5 homebrew and preservation enthusiasts - this isn't really a business opportunity, and the legal footing around porting game binaries is shaky.
business_use_cases: A game preservation researcher studies PS5 binary compatibility for archival purposes.
A hobbyist runs a handful of PS5 games on underpowered PC hardware for personal use.
An emulation researcher studies the project's shader recompiler techniques for other porting projects.

money_ideas.idea: There isn't a clean, legitimate revenue model here - any 'play PS5 games on PC' service would run straight into licensing and copyright issues with Sony and game publishers.

steal_this: Don't build a business on this one. If anything is worth stealing, it's the shader recompiler and relinker techniques for legitimate emulation or porting research, not a product.
